summary: An analytics dashboard combining four KPI cards with line, stacked bar, donut, scatter, calendar heatmap, gauge and radar charts.
use: Building an overview page that puts headline KPIs and several chart types on one screen.
spec: `<KpiGrid>` with 4 `<KpiCard`: Revenue `$118k`, Users `94.2k`, Growth `34%`, Uptime `99.9%`, each with a `trend` and an `icon`
Two-column `<Grid columns={{ base: 1, md: 2 }} gap="4">`: `<BarChart` with 4 series and `stacked`, and `<PieChart` with 5 items and `donut`
`<ScatterChart series={[{ name: 'Accounts', data: scatter }]}` with 60 points, `yName="Conversion %"` and `yFormatter`
Second `<Grid columns={{ base: 1, md: 2 }} gap="4">`: `<HeatmapChart variant="calendar"` with `range={['2026-03-01', '2026-09-18']}` and `<GaugeChart value={84} label="Score"`
`<RadarChart` with 5 `indicators` (Speed, Quality, Reliability, Innovation, Support, `max: 100`) and series Team A and Team B
